semantics: Versioned, language-neutral type source. Single authority for cross-language data contracts. Registry content is append-only per version: raising registry_version is the only way to change semantics, and parity tests pin every projection. JSON port of retired shared-layer/src/shared_layer/contracts/registry.py (B38/C54 python retirement); data content preserved verbatim.
hard_rules: No platform-dependent types at any boundary (C long, size_t, raw Windows types are forbidden contract forms).
i64/u64 cross JavaScript as bigint with a decimal-string wire form (JS number is lossy beyond 2**53).
bool crosses as uint8_t/BOOLEAN - never C++ bool at the ABI.
Text is UTF-8 canonical; UTF-16 exists only inside the C# adapter.
timestamp (UTC instant), duration (monotonic elapsed), deadline (monotonic instant) are three distinct semantics.
Large binary/numeric payloads use bounded typed buffers, never expanded JSON number arrays.

presence.required: key must exist AND hold a value (missing or null = error)
presence.nullable: key must exist; value may be explicitly null
presence.optional: key may be absent; absence resolves to default

notes: TypedBufferSpec enforces dtype in whitelist, max_bytes > 0, elements never nullable. IdentifierSpec separates machine keys from display text. CapabilityRegistry (module capability declarations placeholder for Chinese Semantic Engine v2) carries no contract data and is not ported.
